preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the string s for each test case must be between 2 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abc' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.
The total length of all strings s across all test cases must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the smallest valid substring or -1 if no such substring exists.
The length of the smallest valid substring must be at least 2.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i:j].count('a') > s[i:j].count('b') and s[i:j].count('a') > s[i:j].count('c') for i in range(n) for j in range(i+2, n+1) if s[i:j].count('a') > s[i:j].count('b') and s[i:j].count('a') > s[i:j].count('c'))
postconditions.description: The output must correspond to a valid substring where 'a' occurs strictly more times than 'b' and 'c'.
